decisions.subject: Marlin adapter, carrier, default binding and vendored subset
decisions.mature_replacement: ggml CUDA native GGUF K/IQ/Q8/MXFP4 MatMul and GroupedMatMul
decisions.reason: The artificial signed-symmetric group128 Q4 carrier matches no target artifact and has no independent product consumer; all non-historical references are tests, a stale benchmark, build wiring and documentation.
product_actions: delete src/compute_provider_marlin, include/hyle/compute/providers/marlin.h, tests/compute_provider_marlin and third_party/marlin
remove CUDA default binding and public QuantizedWeights alias
remove component/dependency-lock/validation-policy/package wiring
remove or migrate current tests, benchmark target and user documentation

decisions.subject: native Scan and TopK domains
decisions.mature_replacement: ggml CPU provider standard-index route using standard algorithms and ggml scalar conversion
decisions.reason: The mature route accepts the same public Scan F32/I32 and stable TopK F32/F16/BF16/I32 domain, arbitrary selected axis/strides, checked I32 overflow and preserved value bits, and is already preferred at 200 over native 1000.
product_actions: remove native Scan and TopK prepare/execute code and declarations
retain their API and route through ggml CPU standard-index

decisions.subject: remaining compute_provider_native domains
decisions.mature_replacement: oneDNN and ggml CPU are already preferred where their exact contracts match
decisions.reason: Fill, Select, GatedActivation and portions of dtype/layout/checked/alias domains have no complete mature substitute. Other native code is reachable only after preferred providers decline and therefore remains an exact semantic fallback, not a claimed winner.
product_actions: do not add or optimize native math
retain provider at preference 1000 for only domains not accepted by preferred providers

decisions.subject: HYLE native Scan, TopK and Gather implementations
decisions.reason: The CCCL provider already carries F32/I32 Scan with checked overflow, stable F32/F16/BF16/I32 TopK, and bit-preserving I32/I64 Gather with the same bounds, stride, alias and completion contracts, and is preferred at 100 over HYLE native 1000.
product_actions: delete scan/topk/gather native provider and kernel files
remove native dispatcher and CMake references
retain CCCL provider and its original-program tests

decisions.subject: remaining cuda_native provider domains
decisions.mature_replacement: ggml CUDA, cuBLASLt, FlashInfer, SGLang and CCCL are already preferred
decisions.reason: Scatter and portions of Fill/Select/layout/checked semantics are not completely covered by the admitted mature providers. Tensor, norm, reduction, concat and gated code remains only as the lower-priority exact fallback outside mature domains.
product_actions: do not add or optimize CUDA kernels
retain SGLang and CCCL as separately identified mature providers
retain only the residual HYLE provider sources after D4-04

decisions.subject: legacy indexing, reduction and custom ordered-scatter implementation
decisions.mature_replacement: current MLX lower_mature_indexing and lower_mature_reduction paths
decisions.reason: apple_tensor routes Gather/Scatter/Scan/TopK and Reduce/Softmax through the later MLX implementations; the old lower_indexing/lower_reduction entry points have no caller and the custom Metal scatter is reachable only from that dead path.
product_actions: delete apple_indexing.cc/.h, apple_reduction.cc/.h and apple_scatter.cc
remove the five sources from the Apple component

decisions.subject: current MLX and ggml Metal lowering
decisions.mature_replacement: not applicable; these are the adopted mature implementations and lifecycle adapters
decisions.reason: MLX/ggml own the arithmetic, compilation and device resources; HYLE code maps public semantics, checked failure and region lifetime without a duplicate kernel.
product_actions: retain current mature lowering and resource/completion code

decisions.subject: HYLE preferred rank-2 F32 MatMul implementation and packing path
decisions.reason: The route explicitly excludes plain rank-2 F32 MatMul from ggml so the older implementation wins. Existing qualified evidence is parity/inconclusive integration evidence and does not prove a HYLE algorithm advantage.
product_actions: remove the F32 native route selectors, packing code and MatMul lowering
stop excluding plain rank-2 F32 MatMul from the ggml region
remove now-unused ggml shader-copy/matmul variants from HYLE shader generation

decisions.subject: specialized HYLE SwiGLU shader fallback
decisions.reason: The ordinary target domain is already lowered through the mature region before this branch, and no qualified evidence proves the extra HYLE shader wins.
product_actions: delete shaders/swiglu.comp and its special lower_gate branch
leave unsupported exact shapes to the existing generic residual gate or a clear unsupported verdict

decisions.subject: generic tensor, checked I32 scan, ordered scatter and boundary adapters
decisions.mature_replacement: ggml Vulkan and IREE are already selected first in their exact admitted domains
decisions.reason: Fill, Select, checked I32 overflow, scatter assignment/order and misaligned boundary materialization are not all supplied by a single mature program with HYLE public failure semantics.
product_actions: retain only the exact residual shaders and adapters
do not claim them as performance winners or expand their domains

decisions.subject: SIMD foundation, backend resources, completion and Graph planning
decisions.reason: These are reusable infrastructure or non-inference public capabilities, not operator-provider algorithms. The user explicitly excluded the SIMD foundation from retirement.
product_actions: retain SIMD library and route-native device/resource/completion/planning facilities
